# Slider: `jl-slider`

A number picked by dragging along a track that fills in the accent colour.

- Class `JlSlider`, an atom: `import { JlSlider } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/slider

A number picked by dragging, for values where the feel matters more than the digit: a volume, an
opacity, a budget range. When people know the exact number, prefer a number input.

It is the browser's own range input, styled: the arrow keys move it by a step, Page Up and Page Down by more, Home
and End to the ends, and screen readers read its value. The track fills in the accent colour up to the thumb. marks
draws ticks under the track, with labels when you give them.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSlider } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSlider label="Volume" showValue value={40} />
```

```html
<jl-slider label="Volume" show-value value="40"></jl-slider>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `number`, default `0`. The number, kept between min and max, on a step.
- `min` (attribute `min`): `number`, default `0`. The lowest value.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `number`, default `100`. The highest value.
- `step` (attribute `step`): `number`, default `1`. The gap between two values.
- `showValue` (attribute `show-value`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows the number at the end of the track.
- `marks` (attribute `marks`): `Array<number | SliderMark>`, default `[]`. Ticks under the track: numbers, or { value, label } for a tick with a label.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the slider.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be moved or focused.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `input` (`onInput` in JSX), detail `number`: Each move while dragging or pressing keys.
- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `number`: The value was committed: the drag ended or a key was released.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the slider.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The row holding the track and the number.
- `--thumb` (custom property): The thumb size (16px).
- `--track` (custom property): The track thickness (4px).
- `--fill` (custom property): The colour of the filled part and the thumb ring.
- `--rest` (custom property): The colour of the rest of the track.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Basic

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-slider label="Volume" value="40" show-value></jl-slider>
  <jl-slider label="Opacity" value="80"></jl-slider>
</div>
```

### Steps and ticks

A step of 25 with a tick at each stop.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-slider label="Zoom" min="0" max="100" step="25" value="50" marks="[0, 25, 50, 75, 100]"></jl-slider>
</div>
```

### Labelled marks

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-slider
    label="Quality"
    min="1"
    max="3"
    value="2"
    marks='[{"value":1,"label":"Draft"},{"value":2,"label":"Good"},{"value":3,"label":"Best"}]'
  ></jl-slider>
</div>
```

### Disabled

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-slider label="Locked" value="30" show-value disabled></jl-slider>
</div>
```

### Listening

input follows the drag, change fires when it ends.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-slider class="demo-budget" label="Budget" min="0" max="5000" step="100" value="1200"></jl-slider>
  <p class="muted demo-out">Budget: 1200 CHF (saved 1200)</p>
</div>
```

```js
const slider = root.querySelector('.demo-budget');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-out');
let saved = 1200;
slider.events.register('input', (value) => {
  out.textContent = `Budget: ${value} CHF (saved ${saved})`;
});
slider.events.register('change', (value) => {
  saved = value;
  out.textContent = `Budget: ${value} CHF (saved ${saved})`;
});
```
